name: fr3_dual
description: Two FR3s side by side, the new one to the left of 192.168.11.102 (10-23), both bolted down once placed. Datasets stay in the right arm's base (fr3_base, unchanged); the left arm's targets reach its base through fr3_base -> fr3_base_left (B3, arm-arm ball) and, for absolute replay, the world edges (B4). Until the left arm is in service it has no replay_config and the graph no fr3_base_left node, so everything left is refused with that reason.

fr3_base.definition: libfranka O frame of the right FR3 (192.168.11.102) at its current mount

fr3_base_left.definition: libfranka O frame of the left FR3 at its mount
